title: Healthcare Data Sensitivity Classification Levels
description: Sort eight healthcare data elements into four sensitivity tiers by dragging, with immediate feedback and the access rule each tier carries.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: data classification
access control
healthcare privacy
data stewardship
compliance

educational.audience: Undergraduate students and healthcare data practitioners
learningObjectives: Given a sample healthcare data element, the learner can classify it into the correct sensitivity tier (Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted) and identify the access control consequence of that classification.
